### R&D Objectives
1) To develop state of the art facilities in the areas related to programs. 2) To motivate the faculty and student for research and to develop research culture in the institute. 3) To organize the workshop, conference, faculty development program, seminar and expert lecture. 4) To identity the thrust areas considering the individual research interests and develop the facilities and infrastructure accordingly 5) To create the awareness about the funding schemes of Government, AICTE and other research organization and motivate the faculty to get the research funding. 6) To organize the visits to research organizations and national laboratories. 7) To motivate the staff to pursue the higher studies such as Post Graduation and specially Ph.D. and Post Doctorate Fellowship. 8) To create the awareness about patent, innovation and IPR. 9) To encourage the consultancy in related areas of various departments. 10) To motivate the faculty and students to publish/present research papers in journals and conferences. 11) To have liaison with professional societies such as IEI, ISTE, IEEE, IETE, ASME, CSI etc.
